panels.title: Reporting now
panels.description: Boards heard from in the last 15 minutes

targets.expr: count((time() - mesh_board_report_received_timestamp_seconds) < 900) or vector(0)

panels.title: Silent
panels.description: Boards not heard from for 15 minutes or more

targets.expr: count((time() - mesh_board_report_received_timestamp_seconds) >= 900) or vector(0)
sum(increase(mesh_board_crashes[24h]) + increase(mesh_board_panics[24h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Low on memory
panels.description: Boards whose largest free block is under 20 KB

targets.expr: count(mesh_board_heap_largest_block_bytes < 20480) or vector(0)

panels.title: Boards -- one row each, latest report

targets.expr: max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
time() - max by (sender) (mesh_board_report_received_timestamp_seconds)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_uptime_seconds)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_heap_free_bytes)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_heap_largest_block_bytes)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_crashes + mesh_board_panics)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_hops_to_gateway)
sum by (sender) (mesh_board_interface_up)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_paths)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_nodes)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_time_current)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_relaying)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_psram_free_bytes)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_battery_percent)
max by (sender, hash, version, env) (mesh_board_firmware_info)

properties.value: Lifetime crashes + panics, as the board counts them

targets.expr: max by (sender, interface) (mesh_board_interface_present == 1) * on(sender, interface) group_left max by (sender, interface) (mesh_board_interface_up) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_heap_free_bytes) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_heap_largest_block_bytes) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(time() - max by (sender) (mesh_board_report_received_timestamp_seconds)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_crashes + mesh_board_panics) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_paths) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_nodes) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Drops to zero on every restart

targets.expr: max by (sender) (mesh_board_uptime_seconds) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)

panels.title: Who hears whom -- time since heard directly
panels.description: Rows hear columns. From each board's detail report (every 30 min): the one-hop neighbours it heard announce, over any carrier. Empty: not heard directly.

targets.expr: time() - max by (sender_name, neighbour_name) (mesh_link_heard_timestamp_seconds)

panels.title: Topology -- one-hop links
panels.description: Every node a board reports hearing, and the boards themselves. An arrow runs from the board that heard to the node it heard; its figure is seconds since.

targets.expr: max by (node, name) (mesh_node_info)
label_join(time() - max by (sender, neighbour, interface) (mesh_link_heard_timestamp_seconds), "id", "-", "sender", "neighbour", "interface")
time() - max by (sender_name, neighbour_name, interface) (mesh_link_heard_timestamp_seconds)
max by (sender_name, neighbour_name, interface) (mesh_link_rssi_dbm)

panels.title: Propagation nodes -- LXMF stores
panels.description: Boards running a propagation node. Sync counts are since the board booted.

targets.expr: (max by (sender) (mesh_board_pn_store_messages)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_pn_store_bytes)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_pn_peers)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_pn_syncs_ok_total)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_pn_syncs_failed_total)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)

(max by (sender) (mesh_board_pn_last_sync_age_seconds) + (time() - max by (sender) (mesh_board_detail_received_timestamp_seconds))) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(count by (sender) (mesh_board_interface_online == 1)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_radio_channel_utilisation_percent)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_radio_airtime_percent)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_radio_noise_floor_dbm)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(max by (sender) (mesh_board_radio_rssi_dbm)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
(count by (sender) (mesh_link_heard_timestamp_seconds)) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)

panels.title: Received, by carrier
panels.description: Hourly average from cumulative byte counters; a restart reads as a reset

targets.expr: sum by (sender, interface) (rate(mesh_board_interface_rx_bytes_total[1h])) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
sum by (sender, interface) (rate(mesh_board_interface_tx_bytes_total[1h])) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_radio_channel_utilisation_percent) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
max by (sender) (mesh_board_radio_noise_floor_dbm) * on(sender) group_left(name) max by (sender, name) (mesh_board_info)
